Two BUGS found — see below.

ui_bugs.issue: Bil and Skilt rows display '—' instead of 'Tesla Model Y' / 'EL12345'. Root cause: /app/frontend/app/(driver)/profile.tsx reads u.car and u.plate from useAuth().user, but /api/auth/login only returns {id,email,fullName,phone,role,driver_id} — the user object never contains car/plate. The vehicle info IS available from /api/driver/current (fields driver.car / driver.plate) or should be exposed via a /api/driver/me endpoint, but the profile screen doesn't fetch it. Additionally 'Klasse' currently renders vehicleMeta('ai-first').name = 'KJAPP' (service tier) which does not match the review's expected 'Tesla Model Y' — consider showing the actual car model instead. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(driver)/profile.tsx L21-L50.

After login the driver has an active accepted trip and /api/driver/summary/today returns {online:true}, yet the top-bar renders 'Avlogget' with the switch OFF. The poll() sets setOnline(r.online) but it never appears to take effect on the initial render (waited 4.5s across two runs). This is a mismatch between backend online state (true) and UI (AV/Avlogget). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(driver)/home.tsx L36-L46 (poll) and L26 (useState default false). Possibly the summary Promise is being fired without an early cancel guard on unmount, or the setOnline is happening but the display is not re-reading it. Also the useEffect on [online] would then start the location watcher which fails on web (denied geolocation) — expected — but a race between toggle setter and effect can revert the UI. Please investigate.

integration_issues.issue: The Utbetaling card reads payouts?.next_payout but the backend field is payouts.next_payout_date, so the 'neste <date>' hint never renders. Small fix in /app/frontend/app/(driver)/earnings.tsx L116 — change next_payout -> next_payout_date.

react_native_issues.issue: Console still emits: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — surfaces at least twice on the customer home stack (previously reported iter 26/27). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(app)/home.tsx around L426-428 (shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset).

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — new this iteration, triggered by TileMap and vignette View. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/TileMap.tsx L206, L257 — the two <View pointerEvents="none"> / <Text pointerEvents="none"> attributes should be moved into the style prop ({pointerEvents:'none'}) to silence the RN Web 0.76+ deprecation.

Fix online-toggle initial sync in (driver)/home.tsx — ensure setOnline(r.online) from /driver/summary/today actually reflects on the switch immediately, and remove the race with the location useEffect. critical_code_review_comments: TileMap tile URLs bypass any Expo Image caching layer — on slower networks the visible flash between zoom levels can be pronounced. Consider prefetching neighbouring tiles or using expo-image with memory cache.

driver home poll() interval is 4000ms — same as the customer booking poll. During an active trip both interval and location watchPositionAsync run concurrently and each fires a POST /api/driver/location; consider gating location POSTs to when trip.status is on-way/in-trip to save mobile-data.

earnings.tsx computes 'month' from /driver/history slice — that endpoint currently returns only the recent history; for a real monthly figure it should call a dedicated /driver/history/monthly or accept a range param.

The only two functional gaps are (a) driver Kjøretøy card missing bil/skilt because /api/auth/login user object lacks those fields, and (b) driver-online-toggle not reflecting backend online state on first render. To reproduce the online-toggle bug: /api/driver/online true via curl, then open (driver)/home in the browser — top-bar will read 'Avlogget' even though backend + /driver/summary/today say online:true.
rca_of_issue: 1) Driver Kjøretøy '—' — profile.tsx binds u.car / u.plate directly from useAuth().user. Backend /api/auth/login (and presumably /api/auth/me) does not include car/plate on the returned user. Fix on either side: extend the login/me payload with car/plate/vehicle_type for role=driver, OR have the profile screen call an existing endpoint that already carries this data (e.g. /api/driver/current.driver.car / /api/driver/ratings if you add it there). 2) Online toggle mismatch — home.tsx starts with useState(false); poll() sets it from summary asynchronously. Between login navigation and the first successful summary response the switch is drawn as AV; a subsequent re-render should flip it to PÅ but visually it stays AV — probably because the useEffect on [online] sees the transition and its early return (`if (!online) { ...remove watch; return; }`) is fine, but if summary resolves BEFORE useFocusEffect wires the interval, and setOnline(true) triggers the geolocation request which then errors and calls setOnline(false), the state ping-pongs back to offline. That matches what we saw. Recommendation: keep the location watcher gated behind an explicit user toggle only, and treat backend online status as source-of-truth for the UI badge (separate visual state from watcher state).
